violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: staff member was observed wiping nose with back of gloved hand.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. EMPLOYEE REMOVED GLOVES.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: Fresh cream croissants and boba. Facility has also added spicy carbonara danish, ham and mushroom danish, vegetable croquette, pizza croquette, sausage roll bread, and spinach feta danish.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS INFORMED PIC THAT ALL LISTED ITEMS MUST BE HELD USING TPHC. PIC STATED FRESH CREAM ITEM WILL BE HELD IN THE REFRIGERATED CASE MOVING FORWARD. PIC LABELED ITEMS FOR TPHC.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: interior of single door refrigerated prep unit, interior of 2 door undercounter fridge, drying rack above 3 comp sink.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed a leak from the ceiling in front of the ovens.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INFORMED THE STORE MANAGER ABOUT THE LEAK. CAFE L'AMI (Inspection Date: 05/11/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the flooring near the warewashing area and the ceiling tiles above the center prep table are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
